The strongest causal signal is **currencyservice degradation beginning at 18:47**: memory jumps from about 46 MB to 144–240 MB, its p90 latency rises from 0–0.1 to 0.2–0.5, and CPU and socket counts also increase. At the same time, checkoutservice and frontend p90 latency rise, while frontend request rate falls. Currencyservice is a direct dependency of both, making it the best-supported source of the latency incident.

The frontend’s “failed to retrieve ads” messages are a separate clue, but the telemetry does not show a sustained adservice resource or latency anomaly, so it does not support adservice as the main cause.
